CustomerProfile.title: CustomerProfile
CustomerProfile.description: Represents a registered customer's profile, containing personal information and links to their associated data, excluding sensitive authentication credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CustomerProfile entity.

email.description: The customer's email address, used for communication and identification.

defaultShippingAddressId.description: Reference to the customer's preferred default shipping address. (Relationship: CustomerProfile 1:1 Address)

defaultBillingAddressId.description: Reference to the customer's preferred default billing address. (Relationship: CustomerProfile 1:1 Address)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the customer profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the customer profile was last updated.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a luxury handbag item available for sale in the Starbright Atelier catalog.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the handbag, including features, design, and materials.

price.description: The current selling price of the handbag.

currency.description: The currency of the product price (e.g., "USD", "BRL").

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit, a unique identifier for product variations and inventory management.

material.description: The primary material of the handbag (e.g., "Leather", "Vegan Leather", "Canvas").

color.description: The primary color of the handbag.

dimensions.description: Physical dimensions of the handbag (e.g., "H 20cm x W 25cm x D 10cm").

weight.description: The weight of the handbag in grams.

brand.description: The brand of the product, typically "Starbright Atelier".

stockQuantity.description: The number of units of this product currently in stock.

mainImageUrl.description: URL to the main image of the product.

additionalImageUrls.description: An array of URLs to additional high-quality images of the product from different angles.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the product was first added to the catalog.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the product information was last updated.

Address.title: Address
Address.description: Stores physical address details for shipping and billing purposes, reusable across multiple contexts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Address entity.

customerId.description: Reference to the customer this address belongs to. (Relationship: CustomerProfile 1:N Address)

addressLine1.description: First line of the street address (e.g., street name and number).

addressLine2.description: Second line of the street address (e.g., apartment, suite, floor number).

stateProvince.description: The state or province of the address.

postalCode.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the address.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the address record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the address record was last updated.

ShoppingCart.title: ShoppingCart
ShoppingCart.description: Represents a customer's active shopping cart, holding items intended for purchase before checkout.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ShoppingCart entity.

customerId.description: Reference to the customer who owns this shopping cart. (Relationship: CustomerProfile 1:1 ShoppingCart)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the shopping cart was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the shopping cart was last updated.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents a single product item added to a shopping cart, with its quantity and the price at the time of addition.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CartItem entity.

cartId.description: Reference to the shopping cart this item belongs to. (Relationship: ShoppingCart 1:N CartItem)

productId.description: Reference to the product added to the cart. (Relationship: Product 1:N CartItem)

quantity.description: The number of units of the product in the cart.

priceAtTimeOfAddition.description: The price of the product when it was added to the cart, to capture price changes.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the cart.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated (e.g., quantity change).

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer's completed purchase transaction, including details about shipping, billing, and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

customerId.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order. (Relationship: CustomerProfile 1:N Order)

orderDate.description: The date and time when the order was placed.

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the order, including shipping and taxes.

currency.description: The currency of the total order amount.

shippingAddressId.description: Reference to the shipping address used for this order. (Relationship: Order 1:1 Address)

billingAddressId.description: Reference to the billing address used for this order. (Relationship: Order 1:1 Address)

orderStatus.description: The current status of the order (e.g., "Pending", "Processing", "Shipped", "Delivered", "Cancelled").

paymentStatus.description: The current payment status of the order (e.g., "Paid", "Pending", "Refunded").

shippingMethod.description: The chosen shipping method for the order.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number for the shipment, if available.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order record was last updated.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a single product item included in a specific order, detailing the quantity and price at the time of purchase.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OrderItem entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the order this item belongs to. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

productId.description: Reference to the product purchased. (Relationship: Product 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The number of units of the product purchased in this order item.

priceAtPurchase.description: The price of the product at the time it was purchased, to ensure historical accuracy.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order item record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order item record was last updated.

UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: Stores a customer's style and occasion preferences to power the AI-driven product recommendation tool.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserPreference entity.

customerId.description: Reference to the customer whose preferences these are. (Relationship: CustomerProfile 1:1 UserPreference)

occasionPreference.description: An array of preferred occasions for handbags (e.g., "casual", "formal", "evening", "travel").

stylePreference.description: An array of preferred handbag styles (e.g., "minimalist", "bohemian", "classic", "modern", "edgy").

colorPreference.description: An array of preferred handbag colors (e.g., "black", "gold", "neutrals", "red").

materialPreference.description: An array of preferred handbag materials (e.g., "leather", "vegan leather", "satin").

existingWardrobeItems.description: An array of free-text descriptions of items in the customer's existing wardrobe to aid personalized recommendations.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the preferences were first set or created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the preferences were last updated.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following a hierarchical, path-based authorization model, primarily leveraging `request.auth.uid` against document paths and denormalized fields. This approach directly addresses the core design principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, QAPs, and Invariants.

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL MANDATE A):**
All user-specific data (CustomerProfile, Address, ShoppingCart, CartItem, Order, OrderItem, UserPreference) is secured by embedding the owner's `customerId` in the document path, typically as `/customers/{customerId}/...`. This ensures that security rules can evaluate ownership directly from `request.auth.uid == customerId` without needing to perform `get()` operations on parent documents. For sub-subcollections like `cartItems` and `orderItems`, the `customerId` is explicitly denormalized into each `CartItem` and `OrderItem` document. This allows `list` operations on these collections to be secured solely by checking `resource.data.customerId == request.auth.uid`, completely eliminating hierarchical authorization dependencies and enabling atomic write operations (transactions/batches) without security rule failures. This also inherently supports QAPs (Query As Permissions) by allowing direct querying and filtering based on the `customerId` field.

**Structural Segregation (MANDATE B):**
Publicly accessible product data resides in a top-level collection (`/products`). This collection has a homogenous security posture (public read, restricted write), simplifying rules. Private user data, in contrast, is strictly segregated under `/customers/{customerId}/`, ensuring that data with different access requirements are kept in separate, clearly defined logical spaces.

**Access Modeling (MANDATE C):**
*   **Private Data & User-Owned 1:N Data:** Path-based ownership is consistently applied. For instance, `CustomerProfile` is at `/customers/{customerId}`, `Address` at `/customers/{customerId}/addresses/{addressId}`, and `Order` at `/customers/{customerId}/orders/{orderId}`. This makes ownership-based security rules extremely simple and efficient (`request.auth.uid == customerId`).
*   **Continue Hierarchy for Nested Data:** The hierarchical pattern extends to deeply nested user data, such as `CartItem` under `ShoppingCart` and `OrderItem` under `Order`, maintaining clear ownership trails.

**DBAC (Principle 3):** All authorization relies solely on `request.auth.uid` being matched against `customerId` in the path or denormalized within the document, without the need for custom claims. This ensures a database-centric access control approach.

**QAPs (Principle 4):**
*   The `/products` collection supports secure `list` operations for public browsing.
*   For user-specific data, the consistent denormalization of `customerId` within each document (even when it's in the path, it aids in flexible queries and robust rules) ensures that `list` operations on any user-owned collection or subcollection can securely filter by `customerId == request.auth.uid` directly, preventing data leakage and enabling efficient data retrieval without relying on security rules as a filter. This is especially crucial for `CartItem` and `OrderItem` to avoid `get()` calls.

**Invariants (Principle 5):** The structure inherently supports invariants like ownership (via `customerId` in path and document), timestamps (`createdAt`, `updatedAt`), and denormalized data consistency, as these fields are explicitly defined and managed within the document structure.
